name: Bagging / Random Forest
when_to_use: Categorical or continuous dependent variable; reduces the variance of unstable trees; robust to outliers and nonlinearity; needs a medium/large dataset.

expected_input.question: How to reduce the variance of unstable models with multiple trees?

plain_explanation.purpose: Trains many different trees and uses their vote, giving more stable predictions.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want good accuracy without much tuning and with varied data.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with the response and several factor columns; hundreds of rows or more.
plain_explanation.example: Score the prospecting potential of each company.
plain_explanation.diagram: tree 1, tree 2, ... tree 500 -> vote -> final answer
